steps.content: The struggle between the two sides continues. Fissures open and close incessantly across the isolated aerial battlefield. Parts of the Hub's structure collapse and plummet, only to be intercepted and shattered by the FAC before crashing to the ground.
Until a tremor ripples through the entire field. The Hush soldiers guarding EDGE-02 snap their heads up and stare into the distance.

steps.speaker: Hush
steps.content: The Black Ring...
Isn't the red halo... changing?

Is it twisting? Expanding? Splitting? Have the fissures intensified the Mania field? Or was it because the battle destroyed the Hub's barrier, and now the Black Ring is manifesting its true effect on its surroundings, distorting all perception along its perimeter?

The humanoid weapons attempt to assess the situation. Yet in an instant, a light beam penetrates a crack in the barrier, shearing off a strand of the woman's white hair. The units fall into disarray, unsure if they should prioritize protecting their target or responding to the sudden crisis posed by the Black Ring.
Until a command rings out in their minds.

steps.speaker: EDGE-02
steps.content: Protect the Black Ring. Stop the invasion. This is the top priority.

steps.speaker: EDGE-02
steps.content: The Director has let emotion cloud her judgment. She has even forgotten about the Black Ring... which means she also fails to see that... we're no longer the only two parties on this battlefield.
The Ring Weapons, recently compromised by the contamination, suddenly shut down. An 11x11 Rubik's cube emerges, and then...

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: The hero has arrived!
The creator of the Ring Weapon leaps out, reining in her own inventions.
Behind her, dimensional nodes activate, engaging the interference. The Underground's fissures seize up immediately as if shocked by electricity. Several new, thin cracks close up instantly.
And the one coordinating all of this is...
[Scene transition] Another section of the Ring structure

The confinement cell's walls have been blown off. Summer has left two drones to guard the entrance. The three researchers have returned. They've brought back their team leader's assistant and reclaimed their stations.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: ...Keylan-II. Pull up the historical records. Reboot the three nearest secondary terminals. Hack and take over the security system. Progress: 15%, 18%... Accelerate.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: Get my lab back.
[Scene Change]
The alarm signaling an authority override finally sounds. Isomer freezes.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: What...?

steps.speaker: Voice From Behind
steps.content: The young researchers. I brought them back.

Isomer turns around stiffly. While she insisted on confronting 02, ${PlayerName} already broke free. Crimson light from his shackles coils around him, glowing brighter than ever before. The fissures can no longer come near him.
steps.female_content: Isomer turns around stiffly. While she insisted on confronting 02, ${PlayerName} already broke free. Crimson light from her shackles coils around her, glowing brighter than ever before. The fissures can no longer come near her.

steps.content: Has the field generated by the activated Black Ring enhanced his shackles? Or has someone adjusted the rules to adapt to the Mania fissures' traits?
steps.female_content: Has the field generated by the activated Black Ring enhanced her shackles? Or has someone adjusted the rules to adapt to the Mania fissures' traits?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Probably all of the above, I'd say. I don't really understand how it works either. I just listened to the scientists.

options: And with a little bit of acting on top of that, I managed to fool you.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: It's you...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Thank you, Director. You threatened EDGE-02 enough to win them the opportunity to return to the stage.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: And we're all quite relieved. We finally understand what you're thinking.

steps.speaker: Option
options: Now then, shall we enjoy their performance together?

steps.content: [Command Room]
